dropped.summaryEn: The master said children today are always on mobiles and it was different in their time. This is an opinion with no steps.
Memories of joining in 1987, a low salary and walking seven kilometres to school. This is life story, not a classroom practice.
A complaint that government paperwork leaves teachers no time to teach. This is a complaint about the system.
When asked for an example of helping a child who finds reading hard, the master said it happens by itself if you care and love is all you need. This is general advice with no steps.
A memory that the school closed for three days during the village fair. No teaching practice.
